metadata.title: End Process Validation
metadata.purposeAndUsage: MANDATORY final step for every process. Validates that all operating principles were followed throughout the process. Auto-injected by the framework at process creation time.

output.description: Compliance report documenting adherence to operating principles

specificActions: Read log.json to review all user interactions logged during the process
Verify Principle 1 (LOG FIRST): Check that all user interactions were logged BEFORE responses
Verify Principle 2 (READ JSON): Check that step JSON files were read for guidance
Verify Principle 3 (STOP AT CHECKPOINTS): Check that approval checkpoints waited for user response
Verify Principle 4 (NO TODOS): Check that todo_write was not used during the process
Verify Principle 5 (VERIFY ACTIONS): Check that mandatory actions had output confirmations
If violations found: Report to user before completing
If no violations: Output '✓ All operating principles followed - process compliant'
Move process directory from ~/.claude/agentic-processes/active/ to ~/.claude/agentic-processes/completed/ (create completed/ if needed)
bestPractices: Be thorough - check every user interaction in the log
Report violations honestly - do not hide them
Violations should be documented for continuous improvement

substeps.name: Read Process Log
substeps.description: Read log.json to get full execution history
actions: Read log.json completely
Note all user interactions recorded
Note all file modifications

substeps.name: Check Principle 1: LOG FIRST
substeps.description: Verify all user interactions were logged before responses
actions: For each user interaction in the process:
Check: Was it logged to log.json?
Check: Was it logged BEFORE the response/file change?
Note any violations

substeps.name: Check Principle 3: STOP AT CHECKPOINTS
substeps.description: Verify approval checkpoints were handled correctly
actions: For each step with approvalRequired: true:
Check: Did agent stop and wait for approval?
Check: Was approval logged before proceeding?
Note any violations

substeps.name: Check Principle 4: NO TODOS
actions: Review log for any todo_write tool usage
Note if external todos were created

substeps.name: Generate Compliance Report
substeps.description: Document compliance status and any violations
actions: Create compliance report in log.json
List principles checked
List structural validation results
List any violations found
If violations: Report to user and STOP - do not proceed to completion steps
If clean: Output '✓ All operating principles followed' and proceed to completion steps

substeps.name: Update Process Status
substeps.description: Update process status to completed via process-state-update skill
actions: Use process-state-update skill to set process status to 'completed'
Output: 'Process status updated to completed'

substeps.name: Record Completion Timestamp
substeps.description: Record completion timestamp via process-state-update skill
actions: Use process-state-update skill to record completion timestamp
Output: 'Completion timestamp recorded'

substeps.name: Cleanup and Move to Completed Directory
substeps.description: Delete artifact files keeping only essential files, then move process directory from active to completed
actions: Determine current process directory path (should be in ~/.claude/agentic-processes/active/)
List all files in the process directory
Define allowlist of items to KEEP: ["process.json", "memory/", "log.json"]
Delete all files NOT in the allowlist (*.md files, other *.json artifacts) — keep the memory/ directory intact
Verify only process.json, memory/ directory, and log.json remain
Output: '✓ Artifact files cleaned up - keeping only process.json, memory/, log.json'
Check if ~/.claude/agentic-processes/completed/ directory exists; create it if not
Move entire process directory from ~/.claude/agentic-processes/active/{process-id}/ to ~/.claude/agentic-processes/completed/{process-id}/
Verify move was successful by checking new location exists
Output: '✓ Process moved to ~/.claude/agentic-processes/completed/{process-id}/'

flow.description: Read log → Check each principle → Document findings → Report → If compliant: Update status → Record timestamp → Move to completed

complianceChecklist.name: LOG FIRST
complianceChecklist.check: All user interactions logged before responses

complianceChecklist.name: READ JSON
complianceChecklist.check: Step JSON files read for guidance

complianceChecklist.name: USE SUBAGENTS
complianceChecklist.check: Steps executed via step-executor subagent, not directly
